zh-CN.name: 文件化任务规划
zh-CN.shortDesc: 用三份 Markdown 文件充当 Agent 的磁盘记忆，调用后由生命周期钩子自动注入计划上下文。需支持技能钩子（sh 脚本）的 Agent 环境；计划注入与 session-catchup.py 需 Python 3。

en-US.name: Planning with Files
en-US.shortDesc: Use three Markdown files as the agent's on-disk working memory; once invoked, lifecycle hooks inject plan context automatically. Needs an agent that supports skill hooks (run through sh) and Python 3 for plan injection and session-catchup.py.
